content.text: Compare the lengths by dividing the white ribbon's length by the blue ribbon's length.
Calculate 1.8 divided by 0.6.

Dividing by 1/4 is the same as multiplying by 4.

title: Reconstructing amounts after a transfer

content.text: Let the original amounts be 3k and 5k. The transfer changes each amount but not their total.

title: Reconstructing attendance after two changes

prompt.text: At an event, the ratio of adults to children is 4:5. One quarter of the adults leave and 18 children arrive. The ratio of adults to children then becomes 1:2. Find the original total attendance.

content.text: Let the original numbers of adults and children be 4k and 5k.
After one quarter of the adults leave, 3k adults remain. Use 3k:(5k + 18) = 1:2.
